MethylGrapherGraphIndexFiles.description: One converted-graph Giraffe index set (C2T or G2A).
MethylGrapherGraphIndexFiles.title: MethylGrapherGraphIndexFiles

enabled.description: Enable read-level / pattern extraction. Operator-set per site/profile.
enabled.title: Enabled

gaf_patterns.description: Scan alignment.gaf for read-level patterns. Mojo GAFs are multi-GB; set false to use marginal_surrogate tiles after CG H5 write. Operator-set under actionConfig.methylgrapher_wgbs.read_level / methyl_extract.read_level (site/profile).
gaf_patterns.title: Gaf Patterns

tile_size.description: Pattern tile size (bp). Operator-set per site/profile.
tile_size.title: Tile Size

MethylGrapherWgbsStepConfig.description:
Operator-tunable methylGrapher WGBS pangenome knobs (actionConfig.methylgrapher_wgbs).

Asset paths are site-pinned under ``/work/genomes/pangenome/.../d9-bs/...`` and
baked into task ``resolvedConfig`` at instance configuration. Workers must not
re-read site/profile manifests for these values when ``resolvedConfig`` is present.

align_device.description: Portable Align device (dual-Align contract): auto|cpu|nvidia|amd. Used when giraffe_device unset. Operator-set per site/profile.
align_device.title: Align Device

align_engine.description: Align map backend for dual-graph GAF: 'cpu_vg' (stock vg giraffe GAF), 'mojo_giraffe' (Mojo GBZ/GFA→GAF), or 'gpu_giraffe' (prefers Mojo GBZ when packs/READY allow; else vg_autoscale). Operator-set per site/profile via actionConfig.methylgrapher_wgbs (baked into resolvedConfig).
align_engine.title: Align Engine

alignment_mode.description: Must be pangenome_wgbs when this section is used. Set at site/profile/procedure.
alignment_mode.title: Alignment Mode

contexts.description: Methylation contexts to emit as {chrom}-{ctx}.h5 (e.g. CG).
contexts.title: Contexts

conversion_rate_enabled.description: Run Mojo ConversionRate after MethylCall when lambda spike-in assets exist; write bisulfite_conversion.json for methyl_qc. Operator-set per site/profile.
conversion_rate_enabled.title: Conversion Rate Enabled

conversion_rate_sidecar.description: Basename for bisulfite conversion sidecar under sampleDir (default bisulfite_conversion.json).
conversion_rate_sidecar.title: Conversion Rate Sidecar

directional.description: Directional WGBS library (methylGrapher -directional). Operator-set per site/profile.
directional.title: Directional

dual_graph_parallel.description: When true, run C2T∥G2A Align maps concurrently. When false/unset on nvidia|amd DeviceContext engines, serialize haplotypes (avoids dual CUDA context crashes). Operator-set per site/profile.
dual_graph_parallel.title: Dual Graph Parallel

engine.description: methylGrapher implementation: 'python' (stock 0.2.0 image) or 'mojo' (mojo-align image, tag :1.70-mojo). Operator-set per site/profile. Default when unset: python.
engine.title: Engine

giraffe_device.description: Mojo Giraffe device selector: auto|cpu|nvidia|amd. Operator-set per site/profile. Alias of align_device.
giraffe_device.title: Giraffe Device

gpu_giraffe_fallback.description: When align_engine=gpu_giraffe: 'mojo' (prefer Mojo GBZ) or 'vg' (force vg_autoscale). Operator-set per site/profile.
gpu_giraffe_fallback.title: Gpu Giraffe Fallback

image.description: Pinned methylGrapher(+vg) Docker image ref/digest. Or METHYL_METHYLGRAPHER_IMAGE.
image.title: Image

image_digest.description: Optional immutable digest recorded in CAAS fingerprints / provenance.
image_digest.title: Image Digest

index_prefix.description: PrepareGenome-style index prefix under the BS bundle (e.g. .../hprc-d9-bs).
index_prefix.title: Index Prefix

linear_cpg_tsv.description: Optional pre-projected GRCh38 chrom/pos/mC/uC TSV. When unset, extract projects MergeCpG graph.cpg.tsv onto GRCh38#0 paths from {index_prefix}.wl.gfa.
linear_cpg_tsv.title: Linear Cpg Tsv

linear_ref_fasta.description: Linear GRCh38 FASTA matching ref_paths (QC BAM / extraction contracts).
linear_ref_fasta.title: Linear Ref Fasta

methylgrapher_version.description: Pinned methylGrapher version string for provenance / CAAS.
methylgrapher_version.title: Methylgrapher Version

modular_cache_dir.description: Writable Mojo/MODULAR cache inside the container (e.g. /tmp/modular_cache).
modular_cache_dir.title: Modular Cache Dir

mojo_giraffe_ready.description: When false, force vg_autoscale under gpu_giraffe. When true/omit, image default-on Mojo GBZ path. Operator-set per site/profile.
mojo_giraffe_ready.title: Mojo Giraffe Ready

mojo_segments_cache.description: Directory of dense Mojo segment packs (* .mojo_segments). Operator-set per site (e.g. /work/cache/mojo_segments).
mojo_segments_cache.title: Mojo Segments Cache

original_gbz.description: Unconverted graph GBZ used for MethylCall / coordinate provenance.
original_gbz.title: Original Gbz

qc_bam_engine.description: QC BAM remap engine: 'mojo' (MojoGiraffe→linear BAM packaging) or 'vg' (vg giraffe -o BAM --ref-paths). When unset and engine=mojo, treat as mojo; else vg. Operator-set per site/profile.
qc_bam_engine.title: Qc Bam Engine

qc_bam_fallback.description: When qc_bam_engine=mojo and Mojo QC fails: 'error' (fail closed, no vg) or 'vg' (legacy multi-hour vg giraffe BAM). When unset and engine is mojo, treat as 'error'. Operator-set per site/profile.
qc_bam_fallback.title: Qc Bam Fallback

read_level.description: Read-level pattern extraction knobs. Operator-set per site/profile.

ref_paths.description: GRCh38 ref-paths file for surjection / linear coordinates.
ref_paths.title: Ref Paths

threads.description: Worker threads for methylGrapher/vg. Operator-set per site/profile. Stock python MethylCall: keep <=16 to avoid dual in-memory GFA. engine=mojo forces a single GFA worker so higher -t is safe for RAM.
threads.title: Threads

vg_version.description: Pinned vg version string for provenance / CAAS (must match index builder).
vg_version.title: Vg Version

wl_gfa.description: Optional override for PrepareGenome {index_prefix}.wl.gfa (MethylCall + GRCh38 path projection). Defaults to {index_prefix}.wl.gfa beside the bundle.
wl_gfa.title: Wl Gfa

MethylGrapherWgbsStepConfig.title: MethylGrapherWgbsStepConfig

project.description: Legacy alias of projectPath from older input templates (provenance only).
project.title: Project
